correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of system (12) gives a zero-diagonal Jacobian at any interior equilibrium. Its determinant is the negative product of the off-diagonal entries, so the source’s printed sign is wrong. The corrected characteristic equation gives a saddle for \(A_AA_B>0\). The source’s own first integral has a definite Hessian exactly when \(A_AA_B<0\), proving the center case under the opposite sign. Equation (8) gives nonnegative \(A_A,A_B\), and an interior equilibrium requires them nonzero, so the actual tariff model can only realize the saddle sign. Exact-rational and first-integral checks are supplied in verify.py.

value.rationale: The error reverses a central dynamic interpretation: a saddle with separatrix/bistability is described as a center with persistent cycles. Because the model’s own coefficients force the saddle sign, correcting the determinant removes the claimed cyclic mixed-policy regime rather than merely adjusting a local label. This also reconciles the earlier theorem with the article’s later coordination paragraph.
